# Business of Fashion

> > Business of Fashion (BoF) is the leading source for fashion industry intelligence, offering professional education, strategic insights, and data-driven consultancy for fashion, beauty, and luxury brands.

BoF provides masterclass courses, retail strategy training, and consulting services through BoF Insights, partnering with McKinsey & Company, BCG, and Bain to deliver market analysis, brand transformation guidance, and competitive intelligence to industry professionals.

## Key Topics

- Business of Fashion (BoF)
- BoF Insights
- McKinsey & Company
- Fashion education & masterclasses
- Retail strategy
- Brand strategy & transformation
- Luxury brands
- Market expansion
- Community building
- Shopper value & loyalty programs
- Brand acquisition
- Professional development
- Competitive intelligence
- Fashion consulting & advisory services
- PULSE report

- [BoF Insights](https://insights.businessoffashion.com/): Strategy & data consultancy for fashion, beauty and luxury brands
